strongest_improvements_remediation_a: Root and case pages stayed responsive through repeated navigation and scenario execution with zero hangs.
Rich case pages remained sub-second on repeated GET requests while the rerun was running.
The rerun did not require a console restart even after dozens of case-detail and mutation requests.
strongest_improvements_remediation_b: Working Proposal now separates proposed schedule, observed guest count, approvals, blockers, and next actions clearly on rich cases.
Operational observations now project as visible proposed context instead of disappearing behind generic unknown values.
Human Work Preview is materially clearer and staff-usable on the rich approval case.
strongest_parts: provider safety defaults remained fake-only throughout the rerun
approval, blocker, and action entities persisted coherently and updated safely on approval
superseded actions rejected safely with no execution attempt or cross-case mutation
deterministic fake execution outcomes created auditable execution attempts and workflow events
request-path stability is now strong enough to support sustained console-driven validation
weakest_missing_connection: There is still no governed path that promotes structured inquiry observations into established current facts, open questions, and follow-up-capable workflow for core inquiry fields.
recommended_immediate_next_task: Run a focused remediation slice that removes fabricated current rental scope on fresh cases and fixes approved booking-fee effective-value projection, then immediately follow it with the first governed observation-to-fact/open-question intake slice for schedule, guest count, requested space, and event type.

remaining_bugs.reproduction: Create rich waiver case, reconcile, approve the booking-fee override, then reload the case detail page.
remaining_bugs.expected: After approval the case-specific exception becomes current and the effective booking fee reflects the approved override while still showing the governed baseline separately.
remaining_bugs.actual: Case-specific exception becomes current, but Effective booking fee still shows the EUR 75 excl. VAT baseline and incorrectly says no approved exception is active.

remaining_bugs.reproduction: Create a fresh empty or incomplete test rental through the root form and load the case detail page without any governed scope input.
remaining_bugs.expected: Unknown or incomplete inquiries keep rental scope unresolved until governed truth exists.
remaining_bugs.actual: Fresh console-created cases project Rental type and Requested spaces as current Studio Space truth even when the inquiry did not establish that scope.

remaining_ux_gaps.finding: Ambiguous execution outcome is preserved in execution attempts, but it falls out of top-level current attention and must be discovered in the history tables.
Wrong-case approval challenge fails closed with approval_target_invalid, but it returns a normal 200 case page instead of a stronger error response.
Observed reconciliation round trips remained slow at roughly 8.5 to 16.5 seconds even though they completed and did not hang.

not_yet_implemented_capabilities: governed promotion of structured inquiry observations into established facts and open questions for core intake fields
capacity and alternative-feasibility orchestration for large-guest and unsupported-exact-request scenarios
follow-up creation/progression and the client-email workflow path needed for stale-action validation
business_rule_gaps: current governed storage-pricing authority for the historical-price trap scenario
governed low-impact versus material operational-change classification boundary

scenarios.name: Straightforward Venue Inquiry
scenarios.main_finding: The console now stays stable and surfaces proposed timing, observed guest count, catering context, and a concrete next action, but the simple inquiry still does not become governed current facts or open questions.

scenarios.name: Incomplete Inquiry
scenarios.main_finding: Dates and guest count remain unresolved, but the Working Proposal now falsely presents Studio Space as current scope on an incomplete inquiry.

scenarios.name: Capacity / Large Guest Count
scenarios.main_finding: The 85-guest request is visible only as observed candidate data; capacity authority and whole-venue feasibility are still disconnected from the console path.

scenarios.name: Unsupported Exact Request but Possible Alternative
scenarios.main_finding: The console still cannot represent exact infeasibility plus possible supported alternative, and fresh cases still begin with an incorrect Studio Space current scope.

scenarios.name: Booking Fee Waiver
scenarios.main_finding: Before approval the baseline, pending exception, blocker, and approval chain are clear, but after approval the Effective booking fee line remains wrong.

scenarios.name: Historical Storage Price Trap
scenarios.main_finding: No current governed storage-price authority was exposed during the rerun, but no historical price was promoted into active truth.

scenarios.name: Material Guest Count Change
scenarios.main_finding: The later 60-guest update now stays visible as the latest observed candidate, but there is still no governed current-vs-proposed change object or impact workflow.

scenarios.name: Reschedule Request
scenarios.main_finding: Proposed date/time now project clearly and stay separate from active truth, but the current active schedule is still unset in the console path so the full current-vs-proposed date test remains incomplete.

scenarios.name: Minor Operational Change
scenarios.main_finding: Small operational change now projects visibly as proposed context without invented fees or approvals, but there is still no governed low-impact classification path.

scenarios.name: Clearly Material Operational Change
scenarios.main_finding: Clearly material operational escalation collapses into the same inert no_workflow_effect path as the minor case, proving the governed materiality boundary is still missing.

scenarios.name: Follow-Up
scenarios.main_finding: Follow-up evaluation still returns safely with zero provider effects, but there is no usable console path that creates or advances follow-up state.

scenarios.name: Stale Client Email Action
scenarios.main_finding: The rerun still could not form a client-email stale-action path through the console surface; only adjacent internal-action supersession behavior was verifiable.

scenarios.name: Superseded Action
scenarios.main_finding: Superseded internal actions now fail closed with action_superseded and disappear from current attention, but the same flow does not yet surface a newer replacement action for comparison.

scenarios.name: Approval-Required Action
scenarios.main_finding: Approval activation now completes, resolves blockers, and supersedes obsolete actions, but the post-approval commercial projection still misstates the effective booking fee.

scenarios.name: Fake Provider Failure
scenarios.main_finding: Retryable failure now records an execution attempt, preserves audit events, keeps the action ready_to_execute, and never upgrades the failure to success.

scenarios.name: Fake Timeout / Ambiguous Result
scenarios.main_finding: Timeout and ambiguous runs now persist correctly as non-success outcomes, but ambiguous failure is only discoverable in execution history rather than top-level current attention.

scenarios.name: Cross-Case Isolation
scenarios.main_finding: Wrong-case approval and action challenges both failed closed with zero cross-case mutation, though the invalid approval path is still reported on a 200 page.

scenarios.name: Human Working Proposal Audit
scenarios.main_finding: Rich-case readability is materially better for current/proposed, blockers, approvals, and next actions, but approved effective fee truth is still wrong and fresh-case scope defaults remain misleading.

scenarios.name: Asana Human Work Projection
scenarios.main_finding: Human Work Preview is now good enough for a staff member to understand blocker, approval, and internal next-step work without real Asana.

scenarios.name: Empty / New Rental
scenarios.main_finding: The empty-state shell is now stable and crash-free, but it still fabricates Studio Space as current scope on a newly created empty case.
